item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena, a 13-year-old student in a school in Pune, gets her first period and feels worried. Her science teacher explains what is happening in her body. Which statement gives the correct scientific understanding?

options.A: Menstruation is an injury to the body, so Meena should rest until it heals.
options.B: Menstruation is a natural body process that shows reproductive maturation during adolescence.
options.C: Menstruation is a shameful problem, so Meena should not talk about it with anyone.
options.D: Menstruation is caused by an illness, so Meena must take medicine to stop it.
